features.liveCost: SPOT/PERP/STOCK carry model with setup-time funding snapshot, explicit borrow assumption and locate state

features.executionCalibration: Shadow modeled slippage vs next-bar-open proxy with gap MAE/P90
features.liveReadiness: weighted score plus hard gates for strict evidence, provider health, Shadow evidence, execution calibration, drift/governor and valid cost inputs
features.inherited: v62 historical-universe reconstruction and provider/data-integrity center retained
features.marketBreadth: Nasdaq/crypto breadth score from participation, EMA breadth, momentum, advancing volume, highs/lows and divergence; fast/full coverage modes
features.decisionIntelligenceOS: 12 integrated engines: regime, liquidity/structure, cross-asset, conflict, adaptive entry, dynamic exit, portfolio allocation, failure memory, event risk, decision replay, performance control and kill switch
features.edgeValidationV66: 13 validation engines: outcome tracking, confidence calibration, module contribution, proxy ablation, verdict-quality scoring, Setup DNA, edge-decay alarm, regime policy diagnostics, rolling calibration windows, decision attribution, research white/black lists, layer comparison and data sufficiency
features.pionexJournalV71: strict read-only; per-symbol FIFO; base/quote fee conversion; bounded 365-day recursive backfill; incomplete history is never labeled reconciled
features.liveExecutionRemoved: all Pionex submit, close and cancel routes and controls removed from this build
features.botiGridV72: strict read-only pe GET /api/v1/bot/orders; raporteaza profitul NET (totalRealizedProfit), nu cifra bruta de grid; avertizeaza cand opritoarele sunt setate dar stinse, cand pretul iese din intervalul grid si cand lichidarea e sub 15%; PERMISSION_DENIED nu mai trece drept 'zero boti'
features.tablouBotV73: ecran de citit botul de grid pe intelesul omului: pret invechit marcat, basis golit la schimbarea simbolului, zero scrieri in istoric in pana de retea, badge-uri neutre la eroare, buton de mod dezactivat fara strategyId, verdict EROARE (nu FARA_BOT) pe raspuns nevalid, eticheta activ/oprit corecta; pazit de scripts/proba-ecran-tablou.mjs (Chrome real prin CDP, test:ecran)
features.tablouBotV742: selectorul de boti (I9, ultimul punct ramas din revizia finala): cu doi sau mai multi boti apare o lista si omul alege pe care sa-l judece ecranul; alegerea se tine pe disc si trece de un refresh; daca botul ales dispare din lista, ecranul cade inapoi pe automat DAR spune asta, ca omul sa nu creada ca se uita la al lui. Plus: durata la margine nu mai numara peste gaurile din istoric (doua masuratori rare la 200 min distanta raportau 200 de minute continue si aprindeau REGLEAZA pe o dovada inexistenta), si eroarea de ruta spune CE SA FACA in loc de codul brut - "AUTH_REQUIRED" devine "Botii se vad doar de pe calculatorul tau", cu numele bat-ului
features.tablouBotV74: valul de reparatii cerut de revizia finala pe ansamblu, inainte de imbinare: OPRESTE citeste acum marginStatus/riskStatus de la Pionex (nu doar lichidarea calculata), intrare in meniu accesibila si pe telefon (sertarul More), iesirea prin bara de tab-uri opreste WebSocket-ul si ceasul la fel ca navTo(), amplitudinea foloseste ATR adevarat cu high/low (nu doar |delta close|), verdictul foloseste pretul VIU din tickere (nu inchiderea unei lumanari cache-uite 300s), istoricul nu mai inghite pretul spot inghetat in pana de WebSocket, lumanarile se sorteaza dupa timp (nu .reverse() orb), comisionul care curge fara profit brut e cazul cel mai rau (nu nemasurabil), REGLEAZA pe margine cere macar 30 de minute continue

notes: Market breadth is a context/confirmation layer. It does not independently create BUY/SELL orders and does not add live order placement.
